primary_meaning: Outward evidence or produce of inward spiritual condition, especially virtues, character, and good works generated by faith or the Holy Spirit

alternatives.meaning: Children or descendants (fruit of the womb/loins)
Converts, disciples, or spiritual multiplication resulting from evangelism and ministry
Eucharistic wine (the fruit of the vine)
Material blessings, prosperity, or covenant rewards for obedience
Firstfruits as consecrated offering or as Christ/believers in resurrection priority

notes: Biblical usage of 'fruit' is context-dependent and polyvalent, yet Christian teaching and preaching treat the moral/spiritual-produce sense (esp. fruit of the Spirit and 'by their fruits') as the dominant symbolic default; the other senses remain standard within their narrower idiomatic or liturgical settings.
